basis: Approved home-balanced-v3.png, 851x1848; approximate visible artwork measurement normalized to a 393 CSS px stage. Implementation target, not device DPR.
scaling: stageWidth / 393; stageWidth = min(available viewport width, 430 CSS px); center stage horizontally on larger screens
image_rule: Visible box artwork bounds only; excludes name, price and glow. Normalize transparent asset padding. Contain artwork; never stretch or crop.
slot_rule: Size follows active/adjacent position, not box type. Four box types; three visible positions.
